reviews.name: Aleksandrs Kabakovs
reviews.text:
I’ve been going to Kristīne at Augusts for years now, and I honestly can’t imagine trusting anyone else with my hair. She’s amazing with curly hair – she really understands curl patterns and how to cut/style them properly, which is so hard to find.

At this point I don’t even need to explain what I want anymore. I just sit in the chair and enjoy. She knows my hair better than I do.

The whole experience is a treat: a proper head massage during the wash, great music playing, and genuinely useful product recommendations (not just upselling). And a funny but true tip – if they offer you a tea or coffee, say yes. It’s somehow always the best.

Consistent, caring, and just a joy to visit. Do yourself a favor and book an appointment at Augusts. Highly recommend – five stars, no hesitation.

Paldies! 🫶

reviews.name: Aleks Berzins
reviews.text: As much as I love this spot and find the decor cozy and thoughtful, my latest experience was disappointing. At the end of the cut, the hairdresser hesitantly told me it would be 30€ because my 3-year-old "hadn't had a haircut in a while," so it required more effort — otherwise, it would have been 25€. Not only is 30€ the most I've ever paid for his hair, and we've had it cut in several countries, but his hair was about 2 inches long and this was just a regular kids haircut. I personally cut my own hair once a year (or less) and have never been upcharged for that. I wouldn’t have even minded if the haircut had just been 30€ from the start — but the reasoning that his short hair was “a lot to manage” felt disingenuous and left me feeling a bit ripped off.

reviews.name: Maike K.
reviews.text: This place got recommended to me from a local. It is a hidden gem of a hair salon. I got a warm welcome and a coffee to start my visit. The owner of the salon took her time to figure out what to do with my hair and talked to me about what to do. I had some dark "highlights" in my blond hair which was hard to fix. Fixing someone else's work is not easy and I have been very unhappy with my hair for a long time. She took the time to find them and dye them lighter to achieve my wished hair style. I am really happy with the end result and the prize is absolutely fair for the time and effort. She also shared a lot of local tips with me during the appointment. They have a lot of crazy hair styles on their Facebook side, but don't get misleaded by that, they also do traditional styles very well. It is a place for young people with good taste. High quality work. Make sure to book an appointment via Facebook. They do not need advertising since they have people coming back, which is the best review this place can get. Will go again if I am back in Riga.
